name: Reliant Stadium
sources: Wikipedia, NRG Stadium (fetched 2026-09-28): 'In December 2012, it was announced that ... the stadium's end zone displays would be replaced with the largest digital displays in any professional sports venue ... The video screens were revealed August 16, 2013'.
